about: The bench Harmony Touch's test setup as a setup file, every document built from it with no Logitech document as input, by buildTouchDocuments in packages/codec/src/families/harmony-touch/fromnothing.ts. The recipe part is touch-full.json's shape: each device by its name and its catalogue entry in the archive of Logitech's device database, whose commands, codes, power, inputs, states and timing deviceRecordOfArchive writes through our own readers, stated and unverified, decision 15; each activity by its type, devices, inputs and jobs. The touch part holds what that shape does not and the bench setup's description does, written from packages/corpus/touch-setups/8.6-test-setup.json with the same ids of ours: each device's port, repeats, delays, power choices, keys, screen entries and sequences, the LG TV's channel tuning as the person chose it, each activity's place, start screen, power orders, steps, map and sequences; and two things of our own: protocols, the families of our rhythm table every code is written with, each under a protocol id of ours, and settings, the remote's settings as the person chose them, all but the background, which is a picture of ours the builder draws, ourBackground. No account value: Context and the favourites address come from a description of the account kept in the lab.
